facts: The urogenital diaphragm is located in the pelvic region within the perineum.
The deep transverse perineal muscle and the perineal membrane are part of the urogenital diaphragm.
The perineal membrane is a layer of fascia that provides support.
Colle's fascia is a type of superficial fascia found in the perineal region.
Colle's fascia is continuous with the superficial fascia of the abdominal wall.
exclusions: Colle's fascia does not contribute to the formation of the urogenital diaphragm.
